## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days or TQ (300mg) | Not specified |
| **G6PD Intermediate Females** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Close monitoring, proper counselling on AE, and reporting to the health facility |
| **G6PD Deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Treat only in facilities capable of close monitoring, blood transfusion, and after patient counselling |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Close monitoring |
